parameters.name: DnsRecord
parameters.description: Overrides the DNS Record for Origin requests.

parameters.name: Follow302Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to follow 302 redirects from the Origin. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables following redirects.

- `off`: Disables following redirects.

parameters.name: Follow302MaxTries
parameters.description: The maximum number of 302 redirects to follow. Valid range: 1 to 5.

parameters.name: Follow302RetainArgs
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to retain the original request parameters when following a 302 redirect. Valid values:

- `on`: Retains the request parameters.

- `off`: Does not retain the request parameters.

parameters.name: Follow302RetainHeader
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to retain the original request header when following a 302 redirect. Valid values:

- `on`: Retains the request header.

- `off`: Does not retain the request header.

parameters.name: Follow302TargetHost
parameters.description: The Origin `Host` header to use after a 302 redirect.

parameters.name: OriginHost
parameters.description: The `Host` header to use in Origin requests.

parameters.name: OriginHttpPort
parameters.description: The Origin Port to use for HTTP Origin requests.

parameters.name: OriginHttpsPort
parameters.description: The Origin Port to use for HTTPS Origin requests.

parameters.name: OriginMtls
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable mutual Transport Layer Security (mTLS) for Origin connections. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables mTLS.

- `off`: Disables mTLS.

parameters.name: OriginReadTimeout
parameters.description: The Origin read timeout in seconds.

parameters.name: OriginScheme
parameters.description:
The protocol for Origin requests. Valid values:

- `http`: Uses the HTTP protocol.

- `https`: Uses the HTTPS protocol.

- `follow`: Uses the same protocol as the client request.

parameters.name: OriginSni
parameters.description: The Server Name Indication (SNI) to use in Origin requests.

parameters.name: OriginVerify
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable Origin Certificate Verification. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables verification.

- `off`: Disables verification.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use range requests to download files from the Origin. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables range requests.

- `off`: Disables range requests.

- `force`: Forces range requests.

parameters.name: RangeChunkSize
parameters.description:
The size of each chunk for range requests. Valid values:

- `512KB`

- `1MB`

- `2MB`

- `4MB`

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The content of the rule, a Conditional Expression that matches user requests. Not required when creating a Global Configuration. There are two scenarios:

- To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

- To match specific requests, set the value to a custom expression. Example: `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`.

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. Not required when creating a Global Configuration. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables the rule.

- `off`: Disables the rule.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. Not required when creating a Global Configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The priority of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The ID of the site. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: For sites with version management enabled, this specifies the version to which the configuration applies. The default value is 0.
